input_file: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke-scripts (2) (1).zip
note: Screenplay cues inside each recommended clip only, copied unchanged from the parsed screenplay.

cues.text: Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown beaming with cruel triumph.

cues.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
cues.text: Because he is marrying me.
Close-up on Juliana as tears spill over her eyelashes.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: No...
Wide profile shot showing Juliana standing below the altar platform, looking up at Gerald and her sister.
Close-up on Juliana clutching her chest, her sorrow turning into burning outrage.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: You knew this before I walked through those doors!
Medium shot of Gerald standing stoic and impassive next to the smug Lady in Gold Gown.
Close-up on Juliana's hands desperately clenching fistfuls of her white dress fabric.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: You let me come here...
Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she shakes with grief.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: You let me dress in my mother's gown...

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: You let me believe I was walking toward my husband!
Medium shot on Gerald stepping forward, cold and indifferent, with the Lady in Gold Gown lingering in soft focus behind him.
Tight close-up on Gerald's hardened profile as he glances down.

cues.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
cues.text: I changed my mind.
Extreme close-up on Juliana's furious, weeping face.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: You swore you loved me!
Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown smiling condescendingly.

cues.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
cues.text: People change their minds, sister.
Medium profile shot of the Lady in Gold Gown turning her head subtly toward Gerald with satisfied malice.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: And you knew?

cues.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
cues.text: Of course I knew.
Close-up on Juliana, stunned by the callous depth of the conspiracy.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: How long?
Medium two-shot of the Lady in Gold Gown and Gerald looking together down at Juliana.

cues.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
cues.text: Long enough to know he was never going to marry you.
Heavy thud of boots entering wooden floorboards, followed by forceful banging of furniture.
The Constable begins violently overturning crates and dumping contents across the floor.
Medium low-angle shot of Juliana dropping to her knees, frantically trying to salvage bundles of dried herbs scattering across the boards.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Stop! Those are my mother's medicines!
The Constable aggressively pulls folded bed linens from a shelf and hurls them onto the damp floor.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana crawling on the floor, looking up with tears streaming down her cheeks.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Please! There is nothing here!
Close-up of the Constable's hands flipping open a small wooden keepsake box on a work table.

cues.speaker: CONSTABLE
cues.text: Then you have nothing to fear.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana clutching the fallen linens to her chest, her voice breaking.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Those are all I have left!
Medium shot of Gerald leaning casually against the cottage doorframe, looking around with contemptuous disgust.

cues.speaker: GERALD
cues.text: Stand aside. Look at this place. A perfect hiding hole for a thief.
Medium shot of Juliana rising to her feet, clutching the folded cloth, her face contorting with rage.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: You planted this accusation because you cannot bear that I am happy without you!
Tight close-up of Gerald's face chilling into a cold sneer.

cues.speaker: GERALD
cues.text: Happy?
Medium shot of Alexander standing in the cottage shadows, eyes locked onto Gerald.
Extreme close-up of Alexander's right hand slowly tightening into a white-knuckled fist.
Low-angle close-up of Gerald tilting his chin up, daringly baiting Alexander.

cues.speaker: GERALD
cues.text: What is it, soldier? Going to strike a gentleman in front of his wife?

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Don't!
Two-shot framing the noblewoman looking down at Juliana, bursting into mocking laughter.

cues.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
cues.text: You thought? A new maid thinks she knows better than the physicians?
Close-up of Juliana's resolute expression, her eyes flashing with righteous urgency.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: She is suffering.
Tight close-up of the noblewoman's face twisting into a malicious sneer.

cues.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
cues.text: Then let her suffer.
Close-up of Juliana recoiling slightly in shock at the blatant cruelty.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: I cannot do that.
The noblewoman suddenly rears back her riding crop and strikes Juliana violently across the torso.
A sharp, stinging whip crack as the riding crop makes harsh contact.
Juliana gasps in pain, clutching her stomach and bending over as she absorbs the brutal strike.
Medium shot of Juliana hunched over in pain, clutching her abdomen.

cues.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
cues.text: You are a maid.
Low-angle shot looking past the bedpost toward the Duchess, whose trembling hand reaches out limply.

cues.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
cues.text: Not a physician. Not a lady.
Dramatic low-angle wide shot of the noblewoman standing imperiously over the doubled-over Juliana.

cues.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
cues.text: And certainly not a woman whose opinion matters.
Close-up of Juliana looking down, enduring the humiliation while stifling her breath.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: Yes, my lady.
Medium shot of the noblewoman turning the crop in her white-gloved hands with smug satisfaction.

cues.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
cues.text: Good. Perhaps we can teach you your place.
The noblewoman leads Juliana and a frightened Prudence down a dark flagstone hallway.
Low tracking shot down the corridor as the hem of the lilac dress sweeps past, followed by Juliana's swift steps.
Alexander points upward with urgency, pulling her under his arm.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Juliana, the ceiling is coming down!
Juliana wrests her hand from his grasp and charges straight toward the burning desk.
Wide shot of the room as a massive burning crossbeam collapses into the floorboards with a fiery explosion.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Juliana!

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: It's my mother's!
Juliana snatches the scorched leather ledger from the burning table, pulling it tightly against her chest with both bandaged hands.
Close-up of the ceiling rafter splitting violently apart above her.
Close-up of Juliana looking up in sheer terror, firelight dancing across her tearful face.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Alexander!
Alexander lunges across the room, tackling her to the wooden floor and covering her body entirely with his own.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Down!
Massive wooden beam crashes directly where Juliana had been standing, showering them in sparks.
Ground-level shot of Alexander lying on top of Juliana, his chest shielding her, his face smeared with soot.
Alexander lifts his head slightly, checking her face and cradling her cheek tenderly.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: I've got you.
Wide shot of the walls collapsing in curtains of flame, cutting off all interior hallways.
Alexander scoops Juliana up in his arms, carrying her bridal-style as she clutches the ledger.
Juliana looks toward the side wall and points frantically at the parlor window.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: The window!

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Hold on to me.
Medium close-up of Alexander gritting his teeth, holding Juliana securely as she buries her face into his neck.
Slow-motion shot as Alexander sprints through the burning room toward the framed glass window.
Alexander leaps forward, using his shoulder and back to shatter through the burning window frame, carrying Juliana safely in his arms out into the night.
Loud explosion of shattering window glass and splintering wood.
Medium three-shot framing Rupert, the Elder Nobleman between them, and Catherine listening closely.

cues.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
cues.text: Do not hide the evidence, manufacture it. Drag her before the magistrate tomorrow, frame the trial, buy the jury, and let the State hang her.
Close-up of Catherine smiling with malicious satisfaction, fluttering her fan.

cues.speaker: CATHERINE
cues.text: Her botanical ledger...
Close-up of the Elder Nobleman nodding slowly.

cues.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
cues.text: Exactly.
Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward.

cues.speaker: CATHERINE
cues.text: And the Dowager?
Medium shot of the Elder Nobleman gesturing dismissively with one gloved hand.

cues.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
cues.text: She is weak, confused. No magistrate will trust a dying woman's accusations against a respected household.
Medium close-up of Rupert exhaling deeply, processing the horrifying certainty of their conspiracy.

cues.speaker: RUPERT
cues.text: And Juliana?
Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman staring sternly across the desk.

cues.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
cues.text: She goes before the magistrate tomorrow.
Close-up of Catherine beaming with venomous glee, spreading her red fan wide.

cues.speaker: CATHERINE
cues.text: She will hang. A perfect solution. The town will cheer as the witch's disgraced daughter faces the noose.
Medium shot of Rupert pulling out the desk chair and seating himself with dark resolve.

cues.speaker: RUPERT
cues.text: I will write the arrest warrant myself.
Extreme close-up of the Elder Nobleman's weathered face, his eyes cold and predatory in the firelight.

cues.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
cues.text: Tomorrow, she stops being a prisoner. She becomes a witch.
High-angle shot peering down through the heavy iron dungeon grate into the flooded, pitch-black subterranean wet cells where water drips continuously.
Echoing, hollow water droplets splashing into dark pools beneath stone vaults, accompanied by a somber orchestral swell.
Low-angle medium shot pushing in on Juliana huddled against the wet stone wall, chained by the wrists, shivering in wet rags as faint moonlight filters down through the grate above.
Juliana clutches a rough burlap rag to her trembling chest, her tear-stained face lifting upward in dread and fragile hope as the frame holds, cutting abruptly to black.
Close-up of Lord Ashcroft, his weathered face rigid with aristocratic pride and disgust.

cues.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
cues.text: You will not leave this church carrying the Ashcroft name.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking up at her father. Her hand rises to touch the amethyst heirloom pendant resting at her throat.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: The vows are spoken, Father. I am his wife now.
Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft standing rigid outside the chapel archway, unforgiving and unyielding.

cues.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
cues.text: Then leave as his wife.

cues.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
cues.text: You leave as no daughter of mine.
Low-angle shot tracking Lord Ashcroft's polished black boots as he slowly descends the stone steps toward them.

cues.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
cues.text: Your dowry is revoked.

cues.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
cues.text: Your inheritance is revoked.
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes wide with shock and heartbreak as she holds the ledger close against her chest.

cues.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
cues.text: From this moment, you are dead to the Ashcroft family.
High-angle wide shot of the grand cathedral aisle as a matriarch dressed in an ornate black velvet gown glides toward Juliana.
The matriarch steps into the center aisle, glaring down at Juliana with cold superiority.

cues.speaker: OFF-SCREEN VOICE
cues.text: Oh, don't look so wounded, Juliana.
Medium profile two-shot of the matriarch confronting Juliana face-to-face.

cues.speaker: OFF-SCREEN VOICE
cues.text: You should be grateful you're at least allowed to attend the wedding.
Medium shot of Gerald stepping forward on the altar steps, impatiently gesturing Juliana toward the church exit.

cues.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
cues.text: Go home quietly, Juliana. At least leave this chapel with some dignity.
Profile close-up of Juliana turning her face back toward the altar, tears still shimmering on her cheeks.
Direct close-up on Juliana's face as a steely, defiant smile emerges through her pain.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: Dignity?
Full shot of Juliana standing tall, her posture completely transforming into regal composure before the seated guests.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: You abandoned a woman who trusted you...
Medium profile close-up on Gerald's hardening jawline, Clarissa blurred in the background.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: ...because another woman promised you greater beauty and wealth.
Closer angle on Gerald's uneasy expression as Juliana's voice commands the room.
Medium wide shot framing Juliana confronting Gerald from the foot of the altar stairs.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: Do not mistake my heartbreak for your victory, Gerald.
Medium close-up push-in on Juliana, her blue eyes shining with fierce conviction.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: You wanted this entire chapel to believe that I was not worthy of you. But you have shown them something far more valuable.
Medium profile on Juliana looking up at Gerald, holding the entire hall spellbound.
Close-up on Juliana's face, calm, dignified, and unwavering.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: You have shown them exactly what your word is worth.
Medium action shot as the Thug with Cap lunges forward with his weapon raised high.

cues.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
cues.text: Aaargh!
The thug swings the club down with full force, but Alexander catches the weapon mid-air in his bare hand with chilling ease.
Heavy blunt impact of a solid hand gripping wood.
Close-up of the Thug with Cap staring in wide-eyed terror as Alexander grips the bar and wrenches it away effortlessly.
Alexander strikes the thug across the chest and slams him violently into the muddy ground beside the stone wall.
Heavy thud of a body crashing into soil and wood.
Close-up of Juliana watching in breathless astonishment.
Medium tracking shot as the Bald Thug charges in with a shout, only for Alexander to pivot and seize him by the neck, hurling him across the garden path.

cues.speaker: BALD THUG
cues.text: Aaargh!
Loud wooden scrape and crunch as the Bald Thug slides across the planks into the fence.
Medium shot of the Third Thug backing away nervously, raising a blunt rod with trembling arms before lunging.

cues.speaker: THIRD THUG
cues.text: Stay back!
Alexander deflects the strike with his forearm, drives a swift counter-blow into the thug's torso, and spins him violently to the ground.
Solid bone-and-fist impact followed by a groaning thud.
Wide cinematic shot under the full moon. Alexander towers over the three writhing thugs groaning in the mud as Juliana looks up from her knees.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up at Alexander, tears glistening on her mud-splattered cheeks in profound relief.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Alexander...
Medium shot over Juliana's shoulder as Alexander turns his gaze toward her, his stern demeanor softening with concern.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Are you hurt?
Close-up of Juliana's trembling, soil-stained hands wrapped in blood-soaked bandages.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Only my hands.
Medium shot as Alexander suddenly wheels around, strides to the groaning Thug with Cap, and yanks him straight off the ground by his coat collar with one arm.
Alexander lifts the thug onto his tiptoes against the cottage wall, glaring with lethal intensity.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Who sent you?
Close-up of the Thug with Cap gagging under Alexander's iron fist.

cues.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
cues.text: No one!
Close-up of Alexander, his eyes darkening with lethal fury.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Wrong answer.
Alexander tightens his grip on the thug's throat, lifting him higher against the stone wall.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Who?!
Extreme close-up of the terrified thug gasping for air, his eyes bulging.

cues.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
cues.text: Harrington! Gerald Harrington paid us!
Close-up of Juliana on the ground, reeling in devastated disbelief as the betrayal hits her.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Gerald...
Medium wide shot as Alexander releases the thug, sending him tumbling into the ruined flowerbeds.
The Thug with Cap scrambles to his feet and sprints into the dark woods alongside his two limping accomplices.

cues.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
cues.text: We were only paid to destroy the garden, that's all!
Ground-level shot of Juliana's bare hands reaching out onto the cracked, frozen ground.
Sharp blackthorn spines rake across Juliana's fingers and knuckles, carving bloody gashes across her skin.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: No...
Extreme close-up of Juliana's hand scraping against the frost-covered stone, bright red blood welling from deep puncture wounds.

cues.speaker: CLARISSA
cues.text: Look at her hands.
Medium shot on the balcony as Clarissa gleefully points down at Juliana, Gerald chuckling beside her.

cues.speaker: CLARISSA
cues.text: The lady has finally found something worthy of her.
Gerald leans his hands on the terrace railing, sneering callously.
Low-angle medium close-up of Gerald shouting down into the garden.

cues.speaker: GERALD
cues.text: Keep searching, Juliana. Your husband's freedom is somewhere in that garden.
Macro close-up of a massive blackthorn needle stabbing deep into the back of Juliana's bleeding hand.
Sickening crunch and scrape of thorns slicing through flesh.
Close-up of Alexander struggling in agony, tears forming in his eyes.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Please... enough!
Wide tunnel shot through the briars as Juliana crawls deeper into the dark, frozen tangle.
Juliana drags her body across the frozen, cracked soil beneath the dense roof of briars.
Close-up of Juliana's hand getting snagged between two vicious thorns, tearing her sleeve and flesh.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Ah!
Alexander loses control, violently lunging past the Constable toward the briars.
Medium tracking shot of Alexander breaking into a desperate charge.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Stop!
Juliana continues clawing forward, branches lacerating her arm and cheek.
Close-up of Juliana wincing in agony and screaming through clenched teeth.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Ahhh!
Medium shot of the Constable forcefully grappling Alexander by his coat collar, slamming him back against the gate.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Juliana!
Ground-level shot of Juliana frantically digging and scraping at the frozen dirt and dried bramble pods with both bloody hands.
Juliana digs her torn fingers into the frost-hardened earth, turning over rocks and dead vegetation.
Medium close-up of Alexander struggling against the Constable, his face twisted in grief and rage.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Juliana!
Close-up of Juliana lying on her stomach among the thorns, bleeding cuts running down her forehead, cheeks, and bare arms.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Please, ring... you have to be here.
Her blood-smeared index finger brushes against a solid metallic object half-buried in the frozen dirt beneath a thorny branch.
Extreme close-up macro shot of an ornate antique gold ring set with a massive, radiant emerald resting in the frosted soil.
Medium close-up of the Duchess looking upward toward Juliana, her voice trembling with tragic certainty.

cues.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
cues.text: Rupert and Catherine want me dead. They are poisoning me in my own bed, aren't they?
Medium shot of Juliana leaning over the edge of the mattress, nodding earnestly to soothe her fears.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Yes. But the charcoal is fighting the poison. You are safe now.
Close-up of the small amber dropper bottle sitting atop the polished wooden bedside table in the dim glow of the lamp.
Medium shot of the Dowager Duchess looking intently at Juliana from her pillows, studying her bearing.

cues.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
cues.text: Then tell me... why is a girl of such noble spirit working as a common maid?
Close-up of Juliana, her chin lifting with dignified sorrow and quiet defiance.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Because my family cast me out to rot. I have nothing left in this world but my honor.
Medium tracking down Juliana's apron to her hand as she rests it against the bed linens, revealing a distinctive engraved signet ring on her finger.
Juliana rests her right hand against the edge of the bedcover, unwittingly placing the unique ring directly within the Duchess's line of sight.
A sharp, stunned gasp.
Extreme close-up of the Dowager Duchess gasping sharply, her eyes widening in profound shock as all color drains from her face.
The Duchess's mouth hangs open in pure disbelief as she stares fixedly at Juliana's hand.
Medium shot of the Duchess pushing herself up against the headboard, trembling as she stretches out her frail hand.

cues.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
cues.text: Your hand... Let me see your hand.
Close-up of Juliana reacting with confusion and growing concern at the elder woman's sudden frenzy.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Your Grace? What is wrong? You look as though you've seen a ghost.
Close-up shot of the Duchess's withered, shaking hand reaching across the blanket toward Juliana's arm.
The Duchess reaches outward with trembling fingers, grasping frantically for Juliana.
A sudden sharp rustle of fabric as her fingers snap tight.
Tight shot of the Duchess's frail hand clamping down with fierce, unexpected strength onto Juliana's dark sleeve.

cues.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
cues.text: Do not move!
Close-up of the Dowager Duchess looking up at Juliana with overwhelming urgency and tears brimming in her wide eyes.

cues.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
cues.text: Where... where... Where did you get this ring? Speak to me!
Extreme close-up of the Lord's mouth and calculating eyes as he pronounces the lethal word.

cues.speaker: LORD
cues.text: That is witchcraft.
Medium two-shot as the maid steps forward, pleading passionately against his chest.

cues.speaker: MAID
cues.text: No! She saved Toby! She made him breathe again!
Close-up of the Lord calmly watching her futile resistance.

cues.speaker: LORD
cues.text: That will be your testimony.
Close-up of the maid's face frozen in horrified realization.

cues.speaker: MAID
cues.text: My testimony?!
Close-up of the Lord delivering the ultimatum without blinking.

cues.speaker: LORD
cues.text: Before the magistrate.
Close-up of the maid grabbing both sides of her head, screaming out in utter grief and guilt.

cues.speaker: MAID
cues.text: I never said she was a witch!
Medium tracking shot of the Lord turning his back and walking back behind his desk.

cues.speaker: LORD
cues.text: You do not need to.

cues.speaker: LORD
cues.text: I have already written the story for you.
Close-up of the maid clutching her cheeks, crying in heartbreak.

cues.speaker: MAID
cues.text: She saved my brother...
Close-up of the Lord turning back, resting one hand upon the desk with cold finality.

cues.speaker: LORD
cues.text: And now... you will save your brother.
The maid's knees buckle completely. She collapses forward onto the polished dark wood floor, groveling in total despair.
High angle looking down as the maid falls prostrate on the floor.

cues.speaker: MAID
cues.text: I am sorry, Lady Juliana...
Low-angle shot of the Lord looking down dismissively at the prostrate maid.

cues.speaker: LORD
cues.text: Save your tears for the trial.
Side medium shot of the maid kneeling crumpled on the floor in the dimly lit study, her face buried in both hands, weeping uncontrollably as the scene slowly fades into the dark silence.
Medium close-up of Gerald pointing an accusatory finger, his composure snapping into hostile anger.

cues.speaker: GERALD
cues.text: Your husband stole my gold pocket watch!
Close-up of Juliana recoiling in utter disbelief.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: What? When?
Close-up of Gerald narrowing his eyes vindictively.

cues.speaker: GERALD
cues.text: The last time I came here.
Medium shot of Juliana scoffing, stepping forward as Alexander stands motionless behind her.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: You never even entered the cottage!
Close-up of Gerald smirking with condescending amusement.

cues.speaker: GERALD
cues.text: Then you should have nothing to fear from a search.
Three-shot of Alexander, Juliana, and Gerald in the bleak drizzle.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Alexander would never steal from you.
Low-angle shot of Gerald throwing his head back in arrogant, mocking laughter.

cues.speaker: GERALD
cues.text: Of course you would defend him. You married a beggar!
Medium close-up of Alexander stepping past Juliana, his gaze murderous and jaw rigid.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Choose your next words carefully.
Medium shot of Gerald pointing back toward the approaching Constable, feigning alarm.

cues.speaker: GERALD
cues.text: You hear that? He threatens me again!
Medium shot of the Constable marching into frame between them, holding his truncheon horizontally.

cues.speaker: CONSTABLE
cues.text: I have received a complaint of theft.
Extreme close-up of Juliana, defiant and resolute.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: A complaint is not proof.
Close-up of the Constable gesturing with his truncheon toward the cottage door.

cues.speaker: CONSTABLE
cues.text: Then a search will settle the matter.
Medium shot of Juliana backing up to the doorway, spreading her arms wide to block the entrance.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: You cannot simply invade our home because this man makes an accusation!
Medium close-up of Gerald crossing his arms smugly.

cues.speaker: GERALD
cues.text: If he has nothing to hide...
Extreme close-up push-in on Alexander's scarred face, his eyes smoldering with lethal restraint.

cues.speaker: GERALD
cues.text: ...let the constable search.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Search it.
Medium two-shot of Juliana looking up at Alexander in panicked confusion.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Let them.
Medium shot looking out the doorway as Juliana steps aside and the Constable barges past into the dimly lit cottage.
Heavy thud of boots entering wooden floorboards, followed by forceful banging of furniture.
The Constable begins violently overturning crates and dumping contents across the floor.
Medium low-angle shot of Juliana dropping to her knees, frantically trying to salvage bundles of dried herbs scattering across the boards.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Stop! Those are my mother's medicines!
Close-up of Juliana recoiling slightly in shock at the blatant cruelty.
The noblewoman suddenly rears back her riding crop and strikes Juliana violently across the torso.
A sharp, stinging whip crack as the riding crop makes harsh contact.
Juliana gasps in pain, clutching her stomach and bending over as she absorbs the brutal strike.
Medium shot of Juliana hunched over in pain, clutching her abdomen.

cues.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
cues.text: You are a maid.
Low-angle shot looking past the bedpost toward the Duchess, whose trembling hand reaches out limply.

cues.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
cues.text: Not a physician. Not a lady.
Dramatic low-angle wide shot of the noblewoman standing imperiously over the doubled-over Juliana.

cues.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
cues.text: And certainly not a woman whose opinion matters.
Close-up of Juliana looking down, enduring the humiliation while stifling her breath.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: Yes, my lady.
Medium shot of the noblewoman turning the crop in her white-gloved hands with smug satisfaction.

cues.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
cues.text: Good. Perhaps we can teach you your place.
The noblewoman leads Juliana and a frightened Prudence down a dark flagstone hallway.
Low tracking shot down the corridor as the hem of the lilac dress sweeps past, followed by Juliana's swift steps.
Juliana's boots step down into a dark, rustic chamber dominated by an enormous, blackened stone hearth.
Wide shot of the vast soot-stained stone fireplace. The noblewoman turns back toward Juliana, crop held at her side.

cues.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
cues.text: Clean it.
Medium shot of the noblewoman extending her gloved hand toward the cavernous, filth-laden hearth.
Close-up of Juliana looking up at the towering, soot-blackened chimney.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: All of it, my lady?
Extreme close-up two-shot as the noblewoman steps unnervingly close to Juliana's face, whispering with sadistic relish.

cues.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
cues.text: Every stone. Perhaps when your hands are black enough, you will finally remember what you are.
Juliana slowly drops to her knees on the cold flagstones before the soot-filled fireplace.
Medium shot of Juliana sinking to her knees, her face grim and composed.
Prudence steps toward the noblewoman in distress, her hands clasped tightly.
Close-up of Prudence's anxious, trembling face.

cues.speaker: PRUDENCE
cues.text: My lady—
The noblewoman whips around sharply, thrusting the tip of her riding crop directly into Prudence's face.
Medium close-up of the noblewoman baring her teeth in rage, aiming the crop threateningly.

cues.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
cues.text: Do you want the same punishment?
Close-up of Juliana's stricken expression, her eyes widening in horror.

cues.speaker: CATHERINE
cues.text: And when they find your corpse at the end of the rope...
Side close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward, her voice low and merciless.

cues.speaker: CATHERINE
cues.text: ...no one will remember what was written inside.
Close-up of Juliana screaming back in raw outrage.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: You are doing this because I saved the Duchess!
Medium low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her silk gown, contempt etched across her features.

cues.speaker: CATHERINE
cues.text: I am doing this because women like you forget their place.
Quick pan from Juliana's apron up to Catherine's face.

cues.speaker: CATHERINE
cues.text: You were cast out once.
Extreme close-up on Catherine's smiling lips and cold blue eyes.

cues.speaker: CATHERINE
cues.text: You should have stayed forgotten.
Close-up of Juliana raising her chin, unwavering pride breaking through her tears.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: My husband will find me.
Medium shot of Catherine letting out a scornful laugh, tilting her head.

cues.speaker: CATHERINE
cues.text: Your scarred soldier?
Close-up of Catherine's face hardening into sharp mockery.

cues.speaker: CATHERINE
cues.text: What exactly do you think a penniless veteran can do against Ashbrook?
Close-up of the High Priest looking down, a sinister, condescending smirk gracing his lips.

cues.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
cues.text: Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does.
Slow push-in medium close-up on Juliana, her voice trembling with intense indignation.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Then look at this floor honestly, for once.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: A church called me unworthy.
Quick cut to the High Priest maintaining a smug, impenetrable stare.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: A church chained me.
Extreme close-up on Juliana's face as she shouts at the priest.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Now a church calls my marriage a lie!

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!
Medium close-up of Catherine leaning against a stone archway, whispering with venomous mockery.

cues.speaker: CATHERINE
cues.text: Careful, healer. The floor isn't finished with you.
Close-up of the High Priest pressing the document against his chest, his eyes darkening with anger.

cues.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
cues.text: Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness.

cues.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
cues.text: God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!
Low-angle shot of the High Priest stepping up the altar steps toward them.
Brief insert of Catherine smirking as she watches from the side.
Wide shot of the High Priest waving the letter overhead before the congregation.

cues.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
cues.text: And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!
Close-up of Catherine listening eagerly.
Profile medium shot of Alexander confronting the High Priest face-to-face at the foot of the altar.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal.
Close-up overhead shot of Juliana asleep on her pillow as her eyelids flutter open, gasping and coughing violently from the choking smoke.
Juliana coughs, her eyes widening in immediate alarm as the smell of burning wood fills her lungs.
Juliana bolts upright in bed, tossing off the woolen quilt as she sees the orange glow under the door.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Alexander!
Medium shot as Juliana swings her bare legs out of bed onto the floor, trembling with panic.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Alexander!
Low-angle close shot of the bedroom door glowing intensely, fire licking the wooden floorboards as smoke pours inward.
Juliana sits huddled at the edge of the bed, pressing her bandaged hands against her mouth, coughing and sobbing in fear.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Alexander...
A violent crash as the bedroom door is kicked open.
Framed in the doorway engulfed by blazing orange light, Alexander bursts in, his dark hair flying, looking like an imposing guardian amid the smoke.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Juliana! Get up!
Wide tracking shot as Alexander rushes across the burning, smoke-choked room toward her bed.
Alexander reaches the bed, hoisting Juliana up by her arms into a standing embrace.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: What happened?

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Fire.
Over-the-shoulder shot past Alexander toward the blazing threshold of the main room, beams collapsing across the doorway.
Medium close-up of Alexander wrapping a heavy coat tightly around Juliana's shoulders.
Alexander clutches Juliana against his chest with one strong arm, shielding her face from the sparks.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Stay close to me.
Reverse shot from behind them facing the burning door frame as wall-high flames roar, completely sealing their exit.
Juliana recoils from the heat, clutching Alexander's coat tightly.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: We cannot get through!

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Then we go another way.
Tracking shot as Alexander turns, grabbing Juliana's hand, and pulls her quickly through the burning corridors.
Loud wooden groaning and thunderous crash of burning rafters falling behind them.
Medium tracking shot focusing on Juliana's wide, soot-streaked eyes as they navigate through falling embers.
Close-up of the antique, leather-bound herbal ledger resting on a burning wooden table, the edges of its pages beginning to curl and singe in the heat.
Juliana spots the book and halts abruptly, pointing back toward the burning desk.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: The ledger!
Alexander firmly grips her arm, pulling her back toward safety.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Leave it!
Two-shot of Clarissa and Gerald standing proudly side-by-side in their pew as Clarissa points mocking fingers.

cues.speaker: CLARISSA
cues.text: You have finally found a man as worthless as everyone thinks you are.
Close-up of Juliana's side profile, hurt glistening in her eyes as the insult cuts deep.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking up toward the high arches of the chapel, drawing inward strength.
Juliana closes her eyes briefly and releases a steadying breath.
Low-angle shot looking past the kneeling Mysterious Bearded Man up at Juliana.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: You don't even know me.
Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man gazing upward with unwavering earnestness.
Tight close-up of Juliana's anguished face.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: You heard what they think I am.
Medium shot looking down as Juliana addresses the kneeling stranger directly.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Why would you offer me your name?
Low-angle close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man.

cues.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
cues.text: Because I know what I see.
Medium close-up of Juliana reacting with a mix of suspicion and wonder.
Intimate tight shot framing Juliana's profile beside his dark silhouette.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: And what do you see?
Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man.

cues.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
cues.text: A woman who was betrayed.
Over-the-shoulder shot past the bearded warrior toward Gerald watching nervously from the family pew.

cues.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
cues.text: Not a woman who deserves to be discarded.
Low-angle medium shot of Juliana bending slightly forward, shaken by his words.
Medium close-up of Juliana.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: You don't know what my family has done to me.
Low-angle shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man still on one knee, framed against the stained-glass window.

cues.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
cues.text: I know they have made you stand alone.
Extreme close-up of the ring held in his weathered fingers, Juliana's white silk gown blurred in background.

cues.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
cues.text: You don't have to stand alone now.
Medium shot of Juliana, her pride flaring through her sadness.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: If this is pity, take back your ring.
Tight close-up on Juliana's face, a tear clinging to her cheek.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: I will not become anyone's charity.
Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man holding her gaze directly.

cues.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
cues.text: It is not pity, Lady Juliana.
Intense tight close-up on his piercing blue-green eyes and facial scars.

cues.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
cues.text: It is a vow.
Close-up of Juliana, completely disarmed by the gravity of his promise.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: I don't know this man.
Medium shot of Lady Ashcroft, Clarissa, and Lord Ashcroft seated coldly in the family pew.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: I don't know what waits beyond these doors.
Tight close-up of Catherine's gloved hands grabbing the delicate chain around Juliana's neck.
Catherine ruthlessly yanks the silver locket off Juliana's neck.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: No!
Medium close-up of Catherine holding up the oval silver and amethyst pendant, inspecting it with disdain.

cues.speaker: CATHERINE
cues.text: Where did a gutter rat like you find a silver locket?
Close-up of Juliana crying out in agony, writhing in the guard's iron grip.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Give it back!

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: It belonged to my mother!
Low-angle shot tracking the silver locket as Catherine casually flings it across the stone corridor floor.

cues.speaker: CATHERINE
cues.text: A witch has no need for family heirlooms in the gallows.
Metallic clatter as the silver pendant bounces against the wooden baseboard.
Medium shot of Juliana being dragged further into the doorway, staring helplessly toward her discarded locket.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: My mother's locket!
Medium shot of Catherine walking toward the fallen leather-bound book and kneeling gracefully to pick it up.
Catherine lifts the heavy herbarium, dusting off the cover before opening its aged parchment pages.
Tight close-up of Catherine reading the elegant cursive script inside the front cover.

cues.speaker: CATHERINE
cues.text: Juliana...
Extreme close-up on the handwritten inscription: 'Juliana Ashcroft'.
Medium shot of Juliana freezing in the doorway as she sees Catherine opening her mother's book.
Juliana gasps in horror, realizing her secret identity has been laid bare.
Close-up of Catherine raising her gaze slowly from the book, a wicked, triumphant grin spreading across her face.

cues.speaker: CATHERINE
cues.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft.
Medium profile shot of Juliana sitting at a wooden table beside the glowing fireplace, reading an old herbal medicine book.
A heavy wooden door suddenly creaks and bangs open in the quiet cottage.
Juliana jerks her head up from the book, startled by the sudden intrusion.
Medium wide shot framing the doorway as Alexander stands framed in the dark threshold, panting heavily, his hand pressed against his blood-soaked chest.
Medium close-up of Juliana rising swiftly from her chair, shock and terror flashing across her face.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Alexander!
Close-up of Alexander struggling to breathe, clutching his bloodied coat over his chest.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: It is nothing.
Medium shot of Juliana hurriedly stepping toward him across the stone floor.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: There is blood running down your arm.
Medium profile two-shot as Alexander stands rigid while Juliana confronts him.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: A cut from the tenant fields.
Wide shot of the hearth room as Juliana firmly points toward a wooden armchair beside the fire.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Sit down.
Close-up of Juliana's determined, unyielding expression.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Now.
Medium shot of Alexander reluctantly lowering his heavy frame onto the chair in front of the fire.
Medium tracking shot following Juliana as she brings a wooden washbowl, fresh cloth, and an earthen jar of ointment to the foot of his chair.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: I need to see the wound.
Low-angle close-up of Alexander looking up at her stubbornly.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: It is only a scratch.
Medium shot of Juliana crossing her arms over her chest, eyeing him with quiet defiance.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Then removing your shirt should not trouble you.
Medium shot as Alexander stares at her for a beat before pushing himself up from the chair and shedding his heavy leather coat.
Close-up of Juliana observing him with guarded anticipation.
Close-up shot of Alexander pulling his dark shirt over his head, revealing his muscular torso crisscrossed with jagged battle scars and fresh bleeding lacerations.
Tight pan over the scarred, wounded flesh along his chest and ribs.
Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in horror and deep pity.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Dear God.
Medium wide shot as Alexander sinks back into the chair, exhausted, while Juliana slowly kneels before him on the stone floor.
Extreme close-up macro shot of Juliana's trembling fingers hovering tenderly over the raised, jagged scar across Alexander's chest.
Close-up of Juliana looking up at him, her eyes softened with profound empathy.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: You have suffered terribly.
Close-up of Alexander's weathered, scarred face gazing down at her with quiet stoicism.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: It is over.
Medium close-up of Juliana dipping a linen cloth into the water bowl.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Your scars disagree.
Tight close-up on Gerald's hardened profile as he glances down.

cues.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
cues.text: I changed my mind.
Extreme close-up on Juliana's furious, weeping face.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: You swore you loved me!
Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown smiling condescendingly.

cues.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
cues.text: People change their minds, sister.
Medium profile shot of the Lady in Gold Gown turning her head subtly toward Gerald with satisfied malice.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: And you knew?

cues.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
cues.text: Of course I knew.
Close-up on Juliana, stunned by the callous depth of the conspiracy.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: How long?
Medium two-shot of the Lady in Gold Gown and Gerald looking together down at Juliana.

cues.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
cues.text: Long enough to know he was never going to marry you.
Juliana turns abruptly toward the first row of pews, where her elderly father sits gripping an ornate brass cane.
Close-up on the father's hand tightly gripping the gold curved handle of his walking cane.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: Father...
Wide shot showing Juliana dropping to her knees beside her seated father, pleading with him.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: Tell them this is a mistake.
Close-up on the father's weathered face, looking fixedly at the floor, refusing to meet her gaze.
Close-up on Juliana looking up at him, tears streaming uncontrollably down her cheeks.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: Father... please look at me.
The father tightens his jaw and stony expression, refusing to offer a single word or look.
Profile close-up of the father staring blankly forward.
Low-angle shot looking up at the Matriarch commanding the space with regal severity.

cues.speaker: MATRIARCH
cues.text: Enough!

cues.speaker: MATRIARCH
cues.text: You have embarrassed this family long enough.
Close-up on Juliana as she rises, stung by the utter betrayal.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: Embarrassed you?
Medium shot of the Matriarch gesturing toward Clarissa, who stands elegantly in gold.

cues.speaker: MATRIARCH
cues.text: Clarissa knows how to carry herself.

cues.speaker: MATRIARCH
cues.text: She has beauty, connections, and a future worth protecting.
Medium profile two-shot of the Matriarch confronting Juliana face to face.
Close-up on Juliana, demanding answers in spite of her humiliation.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: And I am what?
Medium tracking shot showing the Lady in Gold Gown stepping past Juliana toward the center.

cues.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
cues.text: You are the daughter people tolerate because they have to.
Close-up on Juliana absorbing the venomous words, her breathing shallow.

cues.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
cues.text: I am the daughter they choose.
Medium shot of the Lady in Gold Gown smiling warmly at Gerald beside the altar candles.

cues.speaker: MATRIARCH
cues.text: Clarissa is the jewel of this family.
Close two-shot of the Matriarch and Juliana standing side by side in profile.
Medium shot framing Juliana looking directly at Gerald, who towers over her coldly.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: So that is what I was worth to you?
Medium shot returning to Gerald, sneering down at Juliana.

cues.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
cues.text: You are far too plain...
Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face, crushed under his biting words.

cues.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
cues.text: ...far too silent...
Medium shot on Gerald turning slightly toward Clarissa as she smiles admiringly at him.

cues.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
cues.text: ...and completely beneath the future I deserve.
Wide shot down the aisle as Juliana takes an agonizing step forward toward the altar, extending a trembling hand.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: Gerald... Look at me.
Close-up on Gerald's cold, merciless face staring ahead unblinkingly.
Tight insert on Juliana's hand clutching the heirloom amethyst pendant resting against her gown.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: You gave me your word before both our families.
Medium two-shot of Gerald and Clarissa standing side by side before the priest.

cues.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
cues.text: Promises change when a better choice appears.
Medium close-up on Juliana clutching her chest, her voice quivering with disbelief.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: A better choice? Is that what she is?
Wide shot from behind Juliana looking up the altar stairs at Gerald with Clarissa linked to his arm.

cues.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
cues.text: She is what I should have chosen from the beginning.
Medium shot of Juliana's father seated prominently in the family pew, clutching his gold-topped cane.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: Father...
Close-up of the father's stern, unyielding face.
Medium shot of Juliana turning toward her father in the pews, imploring him.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: Surely you will not let him humiliate me like this?
Medium shot tracking in on Juliana's father as he leans firmly upon his cane, looking down coldly.

cues.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
cues.text: Gerald has made his choice. Accept it, Juliana.
Close-up on the father's hardening eyes, entirely unsympathetic.

cues.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
cues.text: Do not disgrace us further.
Extreme close-up on Juliana's tear-drenched eyes as the sting of her father's rejection lands.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: You won't even look at me.
Medium shot on Clarissa, beaming smugly as she clings to Gerald's arm.

cues.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
cues.text: Why are you surprised, sister? Look at you.
Tight insert on Clarissa's gloved fingers contemptuously pinching the satin folds of Juliana's gown.

cues.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
cues.text: That plain, old-fashioned gown.
Medium shot of Clarissa smiling radiantly, condescendingly gesturing at Juliana.

cues.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
cues.text: You look like a kitchen maid who wandered into the wrong wedding.
Close-up on Juliana, whose tearful expression begins to tighten with quiet indignation.

cues.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
cues.text: And that quiet little face.
Wide over-the-shoulder shot from behind Clarissa and Gerald, framing Juliana standing solitary down the center aisle.
Medium shot returning to Clarissa laughing at Juliana's expense.

cues.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
cues.text: Gerald needs a real lady...
Medium shot of Gerald tapping his whip against his palm and laughing heartily beside the Constable.

cues.speaker: GERALD
cues.text: A lady's hands will be shredded to ribbons!
Medium three-shot of Clarissa stepping behind Juliana, as Alexander watches helplessly with dark fury.

cues.speaker: CLARISSA
cues.text: Do it, and we withdraw the charges.
Extreme close-up of Clarissa's mouth leaning directly into Juliana's ear, whispering venomously.

cues.speaker: CLARISSA
cues.text: Fail, or refuse, and your husband hangs from the gallows.
Medium close-up of Alexander stepping up beside Juliana, tenderly placing his large hand on her shoulder.
Alexander rests his scarred hand reassuringly on Juliana's shoulder, leaning in toward her.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Juliana, no. Do not let them hurt you. I can handle the law.
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, her hand gripping the fabric over her heart in agony and resolve.
Juliana clutches the front of her rustic grey dress, her breathing trembling.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: I am not letting them take you.
Juliana turns her head sharply back toward Clarissa, her expression hardening with fierce resolution.
Over-the-shoulder shot past Clarissa onto Juliana's determined face, holding on her fierce, defiant stare as the tension peaks.
Tight close-up of Lord Harrington looking down at her, his expression cold and ruthless.

cues.speaker: LORD HARRINGTON
cues.text: She won't be seeing anything for long.

cues.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
cues.text: Good.

cues.speaker: LORD HARRINGTON
cues.text: This place has always been unlucky for Juliana.
Lady Harrington lets out a soft, amused laugh as they reach the heavy wooden cathedral doors.
Dramatic tracking shot following Lord and Lady Harrington from behind as they stride down the candlelit aisle of the cathedral toward their reserved pew.

cues.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
cues.text: She stands beneath God's watch and still gets exactly what she deserves.
Lord and Lady Harrington slide gracefully into the polished wooden pew, smoothing their garments.
Medium profile shot of the couple seated in the pew, looking toward the grand altar.

cues.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
cues.text: We have an excellent view.

cues.speaker: LORD HARRINGTON
cues.text: Of the wedding?
Close-up two-shot as Lady Harrington turns her head toward Lord Harrington with a dark, knowing smirk.

cues.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
cues.text: And everything that comes after it.

Medium shot of Rupert, the Blond Nobleman, standing before the altar draped in floral garlands. He wears an ornate silver-embroidered black formal coat and nervously adjusts his pristine white gloves.

cues.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
cues.text: Everything must go perfectly.
Rupert smooths the lapels of his coat, checking his posture as he waits for the bride.
Medium shot up on the stone balcony overlooking the nave, where an elder conspirator nobleman in black gloves stands gripping a cane.
High-angle wide shot looking down from the balcony across the entire cathedral filled with guests, candles lining the central aisle, and royal guards standing at attention.
Medium shot on the balcony as a Royal Guard in red uniform and tall bearskin hat steps up and bows respectfully to the elder nobleman.

cues.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
cues.text: All entrances are covered?

cues.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
cues.text: Every one, my Lord.

cues.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
cues.text: Good.
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the elder nobleman, his gloved hand resting on the stone balustrade, looking down upon the altar and seated aristocrats.

cues.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
cues.text: By sunset, Ashburgh will have its new Duke and Duchess.
Tight, menacing close-up on the elder nobleman's face as a cold, sinister smile spreads across his lips.

cues.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
cues.text: And its witch will be dead.
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes wide with shock and heartbreak as she holds the ledger close against her chest.

cues.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
cues.text: From this moment, you are dead to the Ashcroft family.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: You truly mean it? You are my father!
Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man, observing Lord Ashcroft with an unblinking, quietly threatening stare.

cues.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
cues.text: And you have chosen to become a stranger.
Profile medium two-shot of Juliana and Lord Ashcroft standing face-to-face against the backdrop of the towering gothic facade.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: No, Father. You chose that long before today.
Medium close-up of Lady Ashcroft, resplendent in navy velvet and jewels, stepping forward with a smirk of malicious authority.

cues.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
cues.text: Enough sentiment.

cues.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
cues.text: And the ledger...
Medium shot as Lady Ashcroft approaches Juliana menacingly.

cues.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
cues.text: ...that belongs to this family.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: It belonged to my mother! It is all I have left of her.
Close-up of Lady Ashcroft laying a jeweled hand firmly on the bound book.

cues.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
cues.text: Then you should have guarded it better.
Close-up on the ledger as Lady Ashcroft violently wrenches it out of Juliana's grip.
Lady Ashcroft snatches the heavy book away and flings it disdainfully into the rain-soaked courtyard.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Barbara, don't!
A heavy wet slap as the leather-bound book crashes into the puddle-slicked stone pavement.
Wide shot inside the pitch-dark cell as the heavy iron door swings open.
The guards shove Juliana violently into the cell; she falls hard onto all fours across the cold, wet stone floor.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Please!
The heavy iron door slams shut with a deafening metallic thud, and the massive exterior bolt grates locked.
Static shot of the locked iron door, deadlocked in total isolation.
Medium close-up of Juliana kneeling on the floor, clutching her chest as hyperventilation overtakes her.
Juliana trembles uncontrollably, her fingers digging into the collar of her rustic dress as terror washes over her.
Extreme close-up of Juliana's tear-drenched face crumpling in overwhelming grief.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: Mother...
Medium shot as Juliana pushes herself off the wet stone floor and dashes toward the barred wicket of the heavy door.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: I have done nothing!
Tight profile close-up of Juliana gripping the rusted iron bars, screaming out into the empty stone corridor.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: I saved her! I healed her!
Medium shot from inside the cell as Juliana pounds her fists rhythmically against the reinforced iron door.
Muffled, dull metallic clanging reverberates as Juliana hammers against the iron door.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: I saved the Duchess!
Medium shot of Juliana slumping down against the rough stone wall, pulling her knees to her chest while weeping softly.

cues.speaker: JULIANA
cues.text: They took my mother's ledger...
Extreme close-up of the Lord's cold eyes and hawkish profile speaking with chilling finality.
The maid gasps in sheer terror, her chest heaving as tears stream.
Close-up of the maid clutching her chest with trembling hands, crying desperately.

cues.speaker: MAID
cues.text: Please, my Lord... he is only seven!
Close-up of the Lord staring down without an ounce of pity.

cues.speaker: LORD
cues.text: Then help him.
Close-up of the maid weeping profusely, cornered and helpless.

cues.speaker: MAID
cues.text: What do you want me to say?!
Wide shot of the study as the Lord stands calmly before the trembling servant.

cues.speaker: LORD
cues.text: The truth.

cues.speaker: LORD
cues.text: She drew something around the bed, did she not?
Close-up of the maid stammering through her tears.

cues.speaker: MAID
cues.text: She... placed dried herbs around him.
Medium close-up of the Lord standing right beside her shoulder, whispering in her ear like an insidious specter.

cues.speaker: LORD
cues.text: Around him.

cues.speaker: LORD
cues.text: Like a circle?

cues.speaker: MAID
cues.text: Yes.
Close-up from behind the maid as the Lord leans close to her ear.

cues.speaker: LORD
cues.text: And she opened her mother's book...
Extreme close-up of the maid's tear-drenched eyes and quivering lips.

cues.speaker: MAID
cues.text: Yes.
Close-up of the Lord delivering the final trap.

cues.speaker: LORD
cues.text: ...and spoke words you could not understand.
Close-up of the maid gasping out in desperate agony.

cues.speaker: MAID
cues.text: She was praying!
Close-up of the Lord grinning with sinister triumph.

cues.speaker: LORD
cues.text: Praying... or chanting?
Wide tracking shot down the cathedral aisle as the massive wooden entrance doors slam open, framed by blinding daylight and mist.
Loud, echoing thud of cathedral doors swinging open violently.
A Catholic Bishop in dark vestments steps through the cathedral doors accompanied by an armed Crown officer.

cues.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
cues.text: No one will bow yet!
Low-angle shot on Alexander and Juliana turning in alarm toward the rear of the cathedral.
Medium shot of the High Priest striding down the aisle, holding up an official royal parchment bearing red wax seals.
The Priest holds up the sealed royal proclamation, holding his rosary beads as he marches forward.

cues.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
cues.text: This ceremony was performed without a Crown marriage license, by a priest without authority to sanctify a ducal union.
Close-up on the High Priest unfolding the document, reading aloud to the congregation.

cues.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
cues.text: These vows were never entered into the Royal Matrimonial Register.
Medium shot of Alexander shielding Juliana behind him as the Crown officer approaches with drawn sword.

cues.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
cues.text: Before the Crown, you are not Duchess of Ashburton.
Close-up of the High Priest scowling directly at Juliana with unyielding authority.

cues.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
cues.text: You are not Alexander Ashburton's lawful wife.
Close-up two-shot of Juliana gasping in terror, clutching Alexander's hand tightly as Alexander glares at the Priest.
Juliana looks up at Alexander in sudden panic, her fingers gripping his leather-gloved hand.
Close-up of Prudence's anxious, trembling face.
The noblewoman whips around sharply, thrusting the tip of her riding crop directly into Prudence's face.
Medium close-up of the noblewoman baring her teeth in rage, aiming the crop threateningly.

cues.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
cues.text: Do you want the same punishment?
Close-up of Prudence flinching in terror, lowering her eyes immediately.

cues.speaker: PRUDENCE
cues.text: No, my lady.
Juliana grips a coarse scrubbing brush with both hands and begins vigorously scraping the thick black ash across the hearthstones.
Close-up shot of Juliana's soot-covered hands fiercely scrubbing the black ash along the stone floor.
Rhythmic, harsh rasping sound of bristles scraping against stone.
Medium shot of the noblewoman leaning casually against the wooden doorframe, watching Juliana toil with smug condescension.

cues.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
cues.text: That is where clever little servants belong.
Medium profile shot of Juliana kneeling by the hearth in the dim window light, scrubbing steadily.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: Let her think I am only a maid.

Juliana pauses scrubbing. Her soot-caked fingers reach into the deep pocket of her apron, carefully feeling the worn leather cover of her mother's remedy journal and the glass dropper bottle securely concealed within.
Close-up of Juliana's soot-stained hand touching the hidden remedy book and the antidote vial inside her apron pocket.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: Let her believe I am ignorant.
Juliana raises her head. Smudges of dark soot stain her fair cheek, but her piercing blue eyes burn with unwavering defiance and unyielding resolve as she stares toward the hallway.
Tight close-up of Juliana's soot-streaked face turning slowly toward the chamber exit, her jaw set firm as dramatic music builds to a powerful crescendo.

cues.speaker: LADY JULIANA
cues.text: I will return. You cannot stop the healer.
Close-up on his mother, gasping with wide, horrified eyes.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
cues.text: A traitor?

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Yes.
Medium shot framing both of them across the wooden table bathed in amber lantern glow.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: We were close to finding him.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Then came the ambush.
Close-up on Alexander's scarred hand clenching into a fist, furiously crumbling the parchment map beneath his knuckles.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: My men were slaughtered.
Close-up of his mother clutching at her throat, tears glistening in her eyes.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
cues.text: And you?

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: I was shot. Left for dead.
Medium shot of his mother placing both hands on the table, leaning forward in disbelief.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
cues.text: How did you escape?
Close-up on Alexander, his eyes dark with the harrowing memory.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: I crawled away from the battlefield, half dead, alone.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: I survived because the men who came looking for me believed I was already dead.
Close-up on his mother as her expression shifts to profound bewilderment and outrage.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
cues.text: Then why did they never tell us?
Close-up on Alexander's intense, piercing gaze.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead.
Low-angle shot on Alexander towering over the fallen Rupert.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: You sold my men to the enemy.
Close-up on Rupert waving his hands defensively, hyperventilating.

cues.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
cues.text: I didn't!
Low-angle tracking push-in on Alexander raising the red-ribboned war document toward the cathedral arches.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: And when you believed I was dead...
Quick reaction shot on Rupert gasping on the steps.
Tight close-up on Alexander's scarred, furious face.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: You took my title.
Extreme close-up on the Crown Official's gloved thumb cracking the red wax seal open.
Brittle snap of breaking sealing wax.
Full shot of the Crown Official standing amidst church debris reading the death register.

cues.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
cues.text: Official death confirmation was filed three months after the ambush.
Two-shot of the Crown Official in the background and Alexander's dark silhouette in the foreground.

cues.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
cues.text: Duke Alexander Ashburn was declared dead.
Wide majestic shot capturing the entire nave, the rows of horrified guests, and the ruined cathedral windows.

cues.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
cues.text: His estate and title were subsequently transferred under false authority.
Medium close-up on Rupert clutching his chest as if choking on his own lies.

cues.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
cues.text: I was told he was dead!
Low shot following Alexander's heavy boots stepping steadily up the stone steps toward the altar.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: You were told exactly what you needed to hear.
Medium shot on Rupert whirling around in a frenzy, pointing his finger toward Lord Sterling.

cues.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
cues.text: Sterling handled the report!
Alexander turns his head sharply toward the side pews.
Medium shot of Lord Henry Sterling silently slipping out of his seat and making a break toward the side exit.
Close-up on Catherine peering out from under her bridal veil in shock.

cues.speaker: CATHERINE
cues.text: My Lord?
Medium shot of Lord Sterling frantically unlatching the heavy oak church door and pulling it open.
Heavy iron latch clicking open and wooden door creaking.
Reverse angle from inside the doorway showing a stern British Police Constable standing directly outside, blocking the passage.

cues.speaker: POLICE CONSTABLE
cues.text: Going somewhere, Lord Sterling?
Fast dynamic medium shot as the cart driver suddenly lunges off the wooden bench.
The driver leaps off the cart, striking the sentry across the chest, seizing his neck, and tackling him violently against the wooden carriage wheel.
Dull physical thuds and scuffling boots on wet stone as the guard groans in surprise.
Medium close-up as a second loyalist emerges from behind the doorway, wrapping his arms around the remaining royal guard's throat from behind.
The loyalist locks the sentry into a tight sleeper hold, clamping a hand firmly over his mouth until his eyes roll back and he goes limp.

cues.speaker: LOYALIST FIGHTER
cues.text: Sleep.
Wide high-angle shot overlooking the stone cathedral steps where both royal guards lie unconscious on the fallen autumn leaves while more men slip inside the opened doors.
Medium low-angle shot of the two loyalist fighters looking up into the overcast sky outside the stone sanctuary.

cues.speaker: CART DRIVER
cues.text: The road is clear.

cues.speaker: LOYALIST FIGHTER
cues.text: Tell the Duke.
Close-up framed into a cracked wooden wall mirror reflecting Alexander with long unkempt hair, a thick beard, and combat scars across his cheek.
Alexander stares solemnly at his rugged reflection, his expression dark and resolute.
Tilt-down medium close-up over a wooden table displaying a pristine navy-and-gold embroidered ducal uniform, ornate lion crest brooch, white cravat, razor, and scissors.
Medium profile shot of Alexander lifting the metal shears beside the window light, raising them toward his hair.
Alexander snips through his overgrown locks, shedding the years of exile and camouflage.
Rhythmic, metallic snips of heavy shears cutting through thick hair.
Medium shot as Alexander trims his beard at the jawline.
Medium shot framed in the mirror of Alexander now handsomely groomed, his trimmed beard framing his fierce, scarred features.
Alexander lightly traces the jagged combat scar across his cheek, eyes burning with reclaimed power.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Enough hiding.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: They buried Alexander Ashwin three years ago.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Today, he comes home.
Medium shot of Alexander lifting his royal navy-blue embroidered ducal coat from the wooden bench.
Medium shot as Alexander steps right up to Catherine, towering over her with righteous fury.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: You poisoned my mother. You tortured my wife.
Extreme close-up split profile between Alexander's angry face and Catherine's gasping, terrified expression.

cues.speaker: CATHERINE
cues.text: I didn't know!

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: You knew exactly what you were doing!
Medium close-up of Alexander turning slightly toward the gathered congregation as his voice rings across the cathedral.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: You hurt the two women who mattered most to me: my mother, and my wife.
Close-up on Catherine's devastated, terrified face as the word shatters her entire worldview.

cues.speaker: CATHERINE
cues.text: Wife?!
Grand wide shot of the ruined cathedral nave as Alexander takes Juliana's hand and walks her proudly down the center aisle.
Alexander and Juliana advance side-by-side between the rows of shocked aristocratic guests.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Before the Crown and before God...
Medium shot as Alexander stops in the center of the nave and raises Juliana's hand high above their heads.
Alexander hoists Juliana's hand triumphantly into the air, presenting her to the nobility.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft is my lawful wife... and the Duchess of Ashburton!
Close-up on Rupert and Mary standing in the pews, their eyes wide with horrified disbelief.

cues.speaker: RUPERT
cues.text: Juliana?!
Wide shot of the High Priest waving the letter overhead before the congregation.

cues.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
cues.text: And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!
Close-up of Catherine listening eagerly.
Profile medium shot of Alexander confronting the High Priest face-to-face at the foot of the altar.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal.
Low-angle two-shot of the High Priest staring up into Alexander's imposing frame.

cues.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
cues.text: The High Religious Council rules on matters of holy matrimony. That includes yours.
Medium close-up of Alexander glaring with icy authority.

cues.speaker: ALEXANDER
cues.text: Then let it prove that in ten days, before witnesses. Not with six halberds pointed at me in my own chapel.
Wide profile two-shot of the High Priest and Alexander locked in an intense standoff before the altar.

cues.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
cues.text: Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice.
